scope: Post-handover October1 source-only research decisions; original150-decision register preserved.

decisions.rule: Read the same frozen discovery roots/history with zero HTTP requests and no financial/outcome joins.
decisions.reason: Determine whether an earlier-disclosure investigation is useful without duplicating the completed source capture or selecting from trading returns.

decisions.rule: Keep all 100 issuers and 4,057 originals, including 190 incomplete financial captures and all issuer/year zero rows.
decisions.reason: A missing financial capture does not erase its metadata event; extraction success must not select the source denominator.

decisions.rule: Original same-CIK 8-K with exact comma-delimited Item2.02; preceding45 and late7 elapsed UTC24-hour units; equal instants separate.
decisions.reason: Use a declared near-filing envelope, preserve ordering boundaries and avoid a silent DST/civil-day substitution.

decisions.rule: Deduplicate only identical dictionaries with all raw origins; retain conflicts and every multiple match, with no nearest/latest choice.
decisions.reason: Metadata alone cannot decide which release concerns the financial period; newer or nearer evidence must not silently overwrite original observations.

decisions.rule: Every candidate retains fiscal-period, component and public-dissemination verification as false.
decisions.reason: Same CIK, a report date and an earlier Item2.02 timestamp do not prove the same financial facts were available; later10-Q S/Q cannot be backdated.

decisions.rule: Retain groups once, all near-window pairs and exhaustive per-Q timing counts rather than serializing distant Cartesian rows.
decisions.reason: Preserve reconstruction and failed/unavailable cases without millions of redundant rows; independently classify the full Cartesian space.

decisions.rule: Use immutable code/input identities, a durable UUID attempt and existing source/historical locks; no shared engine/operator edits.
decisions.reason: Avoid concurrent writer drift and duplicate/resubmitted work while preserving the original research and paper identities.

decisions.rule: Preserve failed v1 and independently version v2 to reconstruct all eight origin fields, retaining full equality.
decisions.reason: The initial representation mismatch was a checker omission; strengthening its independent reconstruction does not justify modifying the actual audit outputs.

decisions.decision: Declare descriptive timing after candidate counts
decisions.rule: Freeze a supplementary diagnostic after prevalence was known but before reading lead distributions; include every primary pair and zero/multiple event.
decisions.reason: Describe timing without choosing a favorable candidate or pretending the diagnostic was declared before all outcome-free metadata counts.

decisions.rule: Freeze deterministic source-only document/exhibit selection and limits before acquisition; verify filer CIK, fiscal period and components before earlier-time features.
decisions.reason: The prevalence supports further source investigation, not strategy promotion or a claim that stale information caused the earlier losses.
